about_short_description.short_description: Infinite is a fintech company that provides accounting integration, global compliance, embedded wallets, and digital payment solutions.

product.name: Infinite Stablecoin Payments Platform
product.description: API- and SDK-based infrastructure that enables businesses and developers to embed stablecoin payments, payouts, settlement, and related compliance capabilities into their products.

product.name: Infinite Accounts
product.description: Dedicated business bank accounts with unique routing numbers that support deposits, withdrawals, ACH, domestic and international wires, and stablecoin transactions through one API-driven platform.

product.name: Compliance Infrastructure
product.description: Embedded business verification, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, reporting, and case-management capabilities for stablecoin and fiat payment flows.

identifier.value: Global Transfers and Fiat Payment Rails

product.name: Global Transfers and Fiat Payment Rails
product.description: Payment connectivity that routes transactions across banking networks and stablecoin networks, supporting ACH, wire transfers, local settlement, and cross-border payments.

identifier.value: Embedded Wallet and Stablecoin Conversion Infrastructure

product.name: Embedded Wallet and Stablecoin Conversion Infrastructure
product.description: Wallet and custody infrastructure that enables platforms to support stablecoin holdings and fiat-to-stablecoin conversions without building wallet operations themselves.

product.name: Accounting Integration
product.description: Accounting connectivity for incorporating payment and transaction data into business accounting workflows; specific integrations and supported systems are not disclosed in the available materials.
